results.name: SP Jain Institute of Management and Research

results.name: Madras School of Economics
results.evidence: MSE's official site says the Government of Tamil Nadu enacted the Madras School of Economics Act 2020 and granted it Institution of Special Importance and degree-awarding authority.
notes: Stored in G6 because it is a state statutory autonomous institute, not a central or state university family.

results.name: Delhi School of Economics
results.evidence: The official Delhi School of Economics site identifies it as the Department of Economics of the University of Delhi, a central university.
notes: Department-level record; parent-institute linking should be handled by the department cleanup pass.

results.name: Jamnalal Bajaj Institute of Management Studies (JBIMS)
results.evidence: JBIMS's official site identifies it as a constituent management institute of the University of Mumbai, a state public university.
notes: Department/constituent-institute parent linking should be handled by the cleanup pass.

results.name: IIIT Hyderabad
results.evidence: IIIT Hyderabad is an autonomous university established by the International Institute of Information Technology Hyderabad Act and is outside the MoE-funded IIIT group.
notes: Domain family is computing; the current families table has no dedicated IIIT-H deemed-family slug.

results.name: DOEACC / NIELIT
results.evidence: MeitY's official NIELIT page describes NIELIT, formerly DOEACC Society, as an autonomous scientific society under MeitY providing degree, diploma and skilling programmes.

results.name: Manipal Institute of Technology
results.evidence: The official MIT Manipal site identifies it as a constituent institute of Manipal Academy of Higher Education, a deemed-to-be university.
notes: Parent-university linkage should be added when the deemed-university family batch is processed.

results.name: Bombay Stock Exchange (BSE) Institute
results.evidence: BSE Institute's official site presents professional finance and capital-market training and certification programmes, not a degree-granting university or college.
